concept.title: Determining effective attribute values
concept.shortdesc: This topic defines the precedence rules for determining the effective value of an attribute.

conbody.p: When determining the effective value of an attribute, processors MUST evaluate candidate values in the following precedence order:

ol.li: Explicit value specified in the document instance.
Default or fixed value provided by the XML grammar.
Cascading value supplied by containing elements or containing maps, where cascading is allowed for that attribute.
Default controlled value supplied by a subject scheme map, as specified by defaultSubject.

conbody.p: Processors MUST evaluate this order from highest precedence to lowest precedence.

For single-value attributes, once a value is established at a higher-precedence step, values from lower-precedence steps do not replace it. For multi-value attributes, additive or non-additive behavior MUST follow the rules of the cascade attribute.
For map processing details, including recursion across referenced maps and the rule that processing-supplied defaults do not cascade to referenced maps, see and .
